verdicts.reason: A: the CTA 'Find It Near You' is shrunk to the same size as the two badges, so it no longer stands out. The headline breaks awkwardly ('Mint is / back'), and the right column is cramped, with the subcopy, CTA and badges squeezed under the phone while the left side under the headline is empty. Its one strength is that the circle stays behind the phone. B has all of A's problems and more: the backdrop circle is split from the phone and dropped behind the headline, where it collides with 'Mint is back'. The badge text is jammed ('BACK BYDEMAND') and the subcopy leaves 'sweet.' alone on its own line.
